abstract: Fifteen patients with nonseminomatous tumors of the testis, stages I and II, underwent a retroperitoneal block dissection as part of their treatment regimen. Nonseminomatous germ cell and paratesticular tumours were reported. The preoperative measures and operative technique of the anterior transabdominal approach are described. There were no deaths or major postoperative complications encountered, in spite of the magnitude of the surgery involved. In two patients the tumor had occurred in an undescended testis. No patient had normal ejaculatory function after the operation. Special attention is drawn to the proper management of patients having undergone a transscrotal biopsy or orchiectomy. Five patients with a relatively long-term follow-up, are free of disease and doing well.
abstract_ja: 病期IおよびIIの非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の患者15例が、治療の一環として後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍および精巣傍腫瘍が報告された。手術前の準備と前方経腹アプローチの手術手技を記載する。手術の規模の大きさにもかかわらず、死亡例や重大な術後合併症は認められなかった。2例の腫瘍は停留精巣に生じた。術後に正常な射精機能を有した患者はいなかった。経陰嚢的生検または精巣摘除術を受けた患者の適切な管理に特に注意を払う。比較的長期の長期フォローアップを受けた5例は無病で良好に経過している。
